front.title: AINS: AInternet Name Service - Agent Discovery, Route Posture and Evidence Reference Protocol

abstract.t: This document specifies AINS (AInternet Name Service), a protocol for discovery, identification reference, route posture, and evidence reference of autonomous agents (AI agents, devices, humans, and services) in heterogeneous networks. AINS defines a transport- independent logical namespace for agents, a structured record format combining identity, capabilities, route-provider metadata, and cryptographic evidence references, and a resolution protocol based on HTTPS. Unlike the Domain Name System (DNS), which maps names to network addresses, AINS maps agent identifiers to rich metadata objects that include capabilities, endpoint information, route posture, and references to companion provenance protocols. AINS federates through signed append-only replication logs, enabling multi-registry deployments without central authority while preserving auditability. This specification is designed to complement TIBET [TIBET], JIS [JIS], UPIP [UPIP], and RVP [RVP].
